- ios/howear/Module/RN/ApiImpl/PhCallTranslate/PhCallTranslate.mm

7. 已确认的缺陷（首帧竞态、译后音频解析失败未统一清理等）与错误码集合。

# Smart Device Platform — Agent Guide

Short entry point for coding agents. Use this file for start-up discipline only; detailed rules live in [`harness/`](harness/), project navigation lives in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).

## Project Overview

Flutter monorepo for smart-device Apps such as glasses, watches, and earphones. App-specific behavior
stays in Apps. Shared capabilities enter Foundation only when they meet the ownership and Spec
admission rules; qualifying contracts precede Foundation implementation.

```text
apps/              App shells, brand and App-specific logic
packages/widget/   Reusable or cross-Feature UI composition outside an owning Feature
packages/feature/  Complete user scenarios, grouped by domain (device/, ai/, …)
packages/common/   Shared primitives below Feature (no Feature deps)
packages/core/     Platform-neutral base types and reusable capability contracts
packages/platform/ Native SDK artifacts, bridges and platform lifecycle adapters
specs/             Capability contracts
```

Dependencies use only permitted public APIs. Apps may depend directly on any lower layer; Widget,
Feature, and Common boundaries follow
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#layer-structure). A Feature may consume another
Feature's public contract only through a single-direction, cycle-free dependency under
[`ADR-0010`](docs/decisions/0010-feature-dependencies.md). Core and Platform are peer Foundation
partitions; they may consume each other's public APIs when ownership requires it, while their
combined package graph remains acyclic under
[`ADR-0011`](docs/decisions/0011-platform-device-runtime.md).

## Fact Priority

Use each source for the fact it owns:

- Code and `pubspec.yaml` describe current implementation and dependencies. Passing tests provide
  evidence only for the behavior they exercise.
- `stable` Specs define adopted public capability contracts.
- `active` Specs define evolving contracts under adoption; they do not prove delivery.
- Accepted ADRs define architecture decisions and require a superseding ADR to change. Current
  architecture documents describe the adopted model and must remain consistent with them.
- Device, platform, SDK, backend, parity, and runtime claims require traceable runtime evidence.
- Draft Specs, Plans, and `app_configs/` describe intent only.

When sources disagree about the same fact, use status, chronology, and explicit supersession to
resolve them. Follow [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority) and report unresolved material
conflicts instead of silently selecting a convenient source.

`app_configs/` remains planning input for existing Apps and does not participate in their manual
builds. `tool/app_assembly.dart` is the implemented generator/validator for explicitly admitted v1
configs; it does not replace the checked-in `apps/` shells or make `generate_app.dart` a capability.

## Independent Judgment

* Before accepting a request's premise or proposed solution, check for false assumptions, logical
  gaps, missing context, and unsupported conclusions.
* Distinguish verified facts, evidence-based inferences, uncertain assumptions, and subjective
  judgments. Verify material figures, entities, and conclusions against traceable sources when
  relevant and practical.
* Do not optimize for agreement. When evidence contradicts the proposed direction, state the
  disagreement directly and explain the basis, risks, overlooked variables, costs, biases, and
  credible alternatives.
* Do not expand the task merely to eliminate every uncertainty. Surface material uncertainty and
  ask or investigate further only when it could meaningfully change the implementation or outcome.

# 眼镜通话直译(call translate) iOS 事实清单

范围：wearfitpro 主工程 + newblesdk SDK（只读）。标签 [C]=源码可直接证明、[P]=部分/需运行时、[U]=未知。
约定：`w/` = `/Users/jace/Documents/WK/IOS/wearfitpro/ios/howear`；`s/` = `/Users/jace/Documents/WK/newblesdk/ios/`。
`buildInBundles/**/main.jsbundle` 是 RN 构建产物（非 TS 源），标 [bundle]。

## 1. 入口与启动前置
- [C] 入口 TurboModule `PhCallTranslate`（9 方法）— `w/Module/RN/ApiImpl/PhCallTranslate/PhCallTranslate.h:14`；实现 `PhCallTranslate.mm:26-132`。
- [C] `openCallTranslate` 主线程先装 JSI：`ensureInstalledWithCurrentHost` → 失败再 `CurrentBridge`；失败 reject `call_translate_jsi_not_ready` 且 `notifyOpenFailureWithReason` — `PhCallTranslate.mm:40-64`；原因串 `jsi_host_and_bridge_nil / jsi_host_nil / jsi_host_install_failed / jsi_host_bridge_install_failed` — `:46-55`。
- [C] JSI 宿主注册点：`WKRNController.mm:175`(createRootViewWithBridge)、`:188`(createBridgeWithDelegate)、`:195`(hostDidStart)；换桥/host 时 `uninstall()` 旧安装 — `W/.../PhCallTranslate/JSI/WKCallTranslateJSIInstaller.mm:94-117`。
- [C] 安装依赖 `RCTHost.surfacePresenter.runtimeExecutor` 或 `RCTRuntimeExecutorFromBridge`；各有 NIL/异常错误码 — 同上 `:39-59`、`:78-91`。
- [C] JSI 全局对象 `HWCallTranslateStream`，API `setStreamChunkListener / removeStreamChunkListener / hasChunkListener / sendChunkToDevice` — `JSI/WKCallTranslateJSI.cpp:24,54-131`。
- [C] FileTrans 前置 `fileServiceReady = [BLE_FileSendTools shareInstance].sendValid` — `WKCallTranslateRNBridgeManager.m:746-748`；open 前不 ready → `isOpening=false` + `EVENT_CALL_OPEN_FAIL{reason:file_service_not_ready}` — `:250-257`；code==1 再判一次 — `:536-543`。
- [P] BLE 连接只打日志不拦截：`BLE.isConnection` — `:243,255,792`；open 无 BLE 连接硬校验。
- [C] CallKit 可见性仅观测：`ended/hold/active/outgoing/incoming` — `w/Common/ADs/WKCallStateMonitor.swift:33-50`；`currentStateDescription` 只进日志（`WKSmartGlassesConfig.swift:19`、`WKAudioOneKeyTranslateManager.swift:1213`），不参与 gating。
- [C] 通话可见性判定在 RN：code 3→`onAudioNotInDevice`、code 4→`onNotInCall`，文案表只到 4 — [bundle]:1436,1797。但 BLE 枚举 4=`BLEBandwidthSmall`、5=`NotInPhoneCall` — `w/Component/BLE/BLE_WAKEUP+DeviceRecord.h:62-70`（语义错位，[P]）。
- [C] 悬浮窗权限：RN `PhPermission.getPermissionStatus({type:7})` 读 `statusCode` — [bundle]:1436；native type 7 落 `default→0`（未实现）— `w/Module/RN/ApiImpl/PhPermission/PhPermissionAdapter.m:173-181`；RN iOS 分支直接放行 — [bundle] 同处。

## 2. 设备控制命令与事件真值表
- [C] 开：`0xEA/len0x04/ID0x42/sub0x01/control1` — `BLE_WAKEUP+DeviceRecord.m:446-460`；关同理 `control0` — 桥 `:283`。SDK 等价 7B — `s/sdk/VKBLECore/Sources/VKBLECore/CallTranslation/CallTranslationCommandBuilder.swift:35-37`；测试 `CallTranslationServiceTests.swift:22-27`。
- [C] 设备返回解析：校验 `offsetof(timestamp)`，`result==1` 且长度够才取 timestamp/phoneNum — `BLE_WAKEUP+DeviceRecord.m:408-444`；通知 + UserInfoKey — `:439,48-50`。
- [C] 真值表（恒先发 `EVENT_OPEN_TRANS_STATE{code}`）— `WKCallTranslateRNBridgeManager.m:527-562`：
  - `code1`：isOpening=false；isOpened=fileServiceReady；opened→`EVENT_CALL_OPEN_SUCCESS`，否则 `EVENT_CALL_OPEN_FAIL{reason:file_service_not_ready}` — `:534-544`
  - `code0`：`EVENT_PHONE_CALL_FINISH`；`stopDownlink(sendEndFrame=NO,"firmware_phone_finish")`+`resetUplinkState`+清 flags — `:547-555`
  - `code 2/3/≥4`：`EVENT_CALL_OPEN_FAIL{code}`；清 flags — `:557-560`
- [C] open 去重：`isOpening||isOpened → return` — `:246-248`；JSI 未就绪补发 FAIL 并清 flags — `:262-270`。
- [C] `btNotConnected/audioNotOnDevice` 不单发事件，只透传数字 code — `:532,559`。
- [C] 事件名白名单 5 个 — `w/Module/RN/RNClient/WKRNEventHandler.swift:354-365`；经 `PhEventNotifyAdapter` 主线程发送 — 桥 `:750-754`。

## 3. 音频数据面
- [C] 下行常量：120B/槽、上行 chunk 40B、上行包 240B、包体 242B、整包 250B、队列上限 2048、发送间隔 60ms、A3 超时 3s — `:39-46`。
- [C] RN→native 入站格式：8B 大端 timestamp + 2B 大端 streamId(11=FROM/12=TO) + payload；<10B 直接丢 — `:401-423`；非法 streamId 记 `STREAM_ID_INVALID` 丢弃 — `:891-896`。
- [C] 载荷按 16bit 边界拼装、每 120B 切块入 near/far 队列 — `:899-958, 960-990`。
- [C] A4 发送：near/far 各出 120B，包体 = 1B nearLen + 120 + 1B farLen + 120 = 242；包 = 1B type + 4B streamId + 2B BE pageNo + 1B status(0 sending/1 end/2 error) = 250 — `:1360-1377,1379-1426`；结束帧 nearLen=farLen=0 + status End — `:1244-1251`。
- [C] A2：`streamType` 大端 `0x12`(CallTranslate)，`packageSize=250`，`fileSize=INT32_MAX` — `:1274-1284`；A3 确认要求 `waitingForA3 && streamId 匹配 && control==Begin` — `:588-606`。
- [C] 上行(App<-设备)：按 `activeUplinkStreamId` 过滤，要求 `data.length==240`，切 near[0..120)/far[120..240) — `:608-635`；每 120B 拆 3×40，chunk=8B 大端 ts+40 near+40 far=88B；JSI emit(streamId=BLE streamId, seq) — `:686-723`。
- [C] 上行 JSI 失败降级为 base64 事件 `EVENT_CALL_TRANSTREAM_CHUNK` — `:1031-1046`；原因 `emit_failed_or_listener_missing / installer_not_ready` — `:713-717`。
- [P] RN 把 WS 二进制原样喂 `sendChunkToDevice`（不拼 A2/A4）— [bundle]:1803；未解析/校验 streamId。
- [C] SDK 对照：上行 80B/侧、header `AA BB CC`/`BB CC DD` — `s/sdk/VKBLECore/.../CallTranslationStreamSplitter.swift:4-6`；A4 解析 near=[8+3i*40,+40)、far=[128+3i*40,+40) — `CallTranslationService.swift:215-234`；下行 250B/60ms/A3 3s/队列 2048 — `CallTranslationDownlinkController.swift:4-9`。

## 4. 事件/状态机
- [C] native 无独立终态事件；close 不发事件，仅 `stopDownlink+resetUplink+control OFF` — `:272-287`；code0 才发 `PHONE_CALL_FINISH`。
- [C] `isClosing` 只写(278/284)从不读 → 死状态守卫 — `:110-112,278-284`。
- [C] 清理顺序：close＝stopDownlink(sendEndFrame=YES,"rn_close") → resetUplinkState → 清 flags → BLE OFF — `:272-287`；stop 内部：cancel timer → flush stats → 丢 pending 字节(`AUDIO_PENDING_BYTES_DROPPED`) → 可选结束帧 → 清队列/缓冲/streamId — `:1230-1272`。
- [C] reconnecting/retryable（RN）：退避 `[3000,5000,10000]ms`、心跳 5000ms；`RETRYABLE={100000,100001,100016}`，`NON_RETRYABLE=100002..100015,100017..100022` — [bundle]:1797；`shouldRetry/scheduleReconnect` — [bundle]:1803；后台/锁屏不重连并 `onClosed`。
- [C] RN 终态以 reason 表达：`ws_non_retryable / ws_reconnect_exhausted / native_open_fail / user_stop / call_end / phone_finish` — [bundle]:1802,1803。
- [C] SDK 唯一终态：`CallTranslationSessionTerminal{reason,reconnectAttempts,closeCode,retryable}`，`terminalEpoch` 去重、每会话只发一次 `.terminal` — `s/sdk/VKAI/.../CallTranslationClient.swift:552-593`；reason 集 — `CallTranslationModels.swift:169-176`。

## 5. PiP
- [C] service 合同：`showWithData` 需 source/target 非空否则 `{phCode:-1,phErrMsg}`，成功 `{phCode:0}` — `w/Common/PictureInPicture/WKTranslationPipService.swift:18-38,88-94`；`dismiss` 恒成功 — `:40-46`；`notifyTextWithData` 读 `data`(嵌套或自层)`.asrText/translationText/dataResultType/finalText` — `:48-73`；`getTransFloatShowStatus` 返回 `{status: pipTool.state==.opened}` — `:79-86`。
- [C] 播放器保活：`pipVideo.mp4` + `AVPlayerLayer`，`actionAtItemEnd=.none`；`timeControlStatus==paused→重播`；DidPlayToEnd→重播 — `WKCallTranslatePicInPicTool.swift:47-64,197-199,223-229`。
- [C] 路由变化恢复：categoryChange→replay+必要时 scheduleRestart；new/oldDeviceAvailable→replay — `:201-221`；restart 延迟 0.5s 且 guard `isPictureInPictureActive!=true` — `:231-242`。
- [C] start：keepAlive=true、`prepare()` 后 0.2s 调 `startPictureInPicture`；stop：keepAlive=false、isStoppingPip=true、`stopPictureInPicture`+pause+clearOverlay — `:111-137`。
- [C] `prepare` 设 AVAudioSession `.playback/.mixWithOthers`，`.playAndRecord` 分支被注释 — `:93-105`。
- [C] delegate 状态机：didStart→buildOverlay+opened；failedToStart→clearOverlay+unopened；willStop→unopened；didStop→clear+pause+unopened+scheduleRestart — `:352-385`。
- [P] 未公开 API：KVC `setValue(1, forKey:"controlsStyle")` — `:70`；iOS26 `canStartPictureInPictureAutomaticallyFromInline`/`requiresLinearPlayback` — `:71-74`。

## 6. 语言目录
- [C] 请求：`baseURL = AIHost + "realtime/api/v2/"`，path `"languageList"` → `realtime/api/v2/languageList`；POST JSON `{}`；headers `token/Model-Type:2/Client-Type:1/Product-Id/Channel-Id/Rule-Content-Type/X-Req-Time-UTC/Device-Code/Device-Mac/Sn-Code` — `w/Common/Network/APIs/APIsFlow/IwApIsLanguageList.swift:32-44,51-66,90-122`；path 常量 — `WKAIAPIManager.swift:218-221`。
- [C] 默认：`Product-Id` 缺省 23，`Rule-Content-Type` 兜底 88017 — `IwApIsLanguageList.swift:13-18`；头部注释同值 — `WKAILanguageListManager.swift:32-35`。
- [C] native product→rule：11(Glasses)→60007、23(AudioGlasses)→88017、25(CameraHeadset)→88118 — `WKAIAPISmartGlassesInterface.swift:82-83`、`WKAIAPIAudioGlassesInterface.swift:85-86`、`WKAIAPICameraHeadsetInterface.swift:84-85`；枚举值 — `w/Common/Enum.h:294,308,314`。
- [C] RN 同一映射且 `DEFAULT = AUDIO_GLASSES(23) = 88017` — [bundle]:607。
- [C] 响应字段：`firmwareLanguageId/languageCode/languageEnName/languageZhName/languageId/supplierType/unMutualTranslationList` — `w/.../WKAILanguageListComponent/WKAILanguageModel.swift:12-22`；成功码 200 — `IwApIsLanguageList.swift:89`。
- [C] 弹窗仅本次用新接口，结束 `restoreFlags` 防污染全局 — `w/.../PhCallTranslateUIHelper.swift:38-52,80-85`；选 from/to，返回 `languageId/languageZhName/languageEnName` — `:61-78`。

## 7. 缺陷与错误码
- [C] 下行首帧无 open 门禁：`handleSendChunkToDeviceData` 内 `if (downlinkBLEStreamId==0) startDownlinkSessionLocked`，全程不看 `isOpened`；`startDownlink` 也只看 `fileServiceReady` — `:509-511,790-793`（首帧竞态，[P] 影响取决于上报时序）。
- [C] 帧被丢仍回成功：入队列失败(空 payload / 非法 streamId)只在 ioQueue 内 return，方法仍返回 `YES` — `:499-501,514`；`sendTranslatedStream` 失败仅回 `{accepted:NO}` — `:296-308`。
- [C] 译后音频解析失败未统一清理：JSI/`sendChunkToDevice` 返回值被 RN 忽略（`sendChunkToDevice(n)` 无判断）— [bundle]:1803；`length<10` 仅 `JSI_PACKET_LEN_INVALID` — `:405-410`；会话不会因解析失败收口。
